**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/28 (Tue) 02:18
- [FACT] User has a snake plant, peace lily, ficus tree, dracaena, and prayer plant.
- [EVENT] User recently got a new peace lily from a nursery while running errands on a Saturday morning.
- [CHANGE] User has been experimenting with different fertilizers for their plants.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on pruning their snake plant to encourage it to bush out more.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To prune the snake plant, the assistant recommended removing dead or damaged leaves, cutting back leggy stems to about half their height, cutting just above a node, pruning back to the soil line if necessary, pruning at a 45-degree angle, and monitoring the plant's response.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for snake plant care included pruning during the growing season, regular watering and fertilizing, and rotating the plant for even growth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For the peace lily, the assistant provided care tips: prefer well-draining soil, moderate watering, bright indirect light, fertilizing during the growing season, and monitoring for pests.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering getting a new planter for their ficus tree and is looking for recommendations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested considering the tree's shape, size, material, texture, color, and drainage when choosing a planter. 
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended planter styles included tall, slender planters, woven or rattan planters, ceramic or terracotta planters, and modern geometric planters.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular brands and retailers for planters included West Elm, Crate and Barrel, Pottery Barn, The Sill, Urban Outfitters, and Amazon.
- [EVENT] User has been using a balanced fertilizer on their snake plant and dracaena.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended a balanced fertilizer with an N-P-K ratio for ficus trees, suggesting water-soluble options and organic fertilizers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested specific fertilizers for ficus trees included Miracle-Gro Indoor Plant Food, Schultz All Purpose Plant Food, Espoma Organic Indoor Plant Fertilizer, E.B. Stone Organics Bloom!, and Dyna-Gro Foliage-Pro.
- [PREFERENCE] User has started using a fertilizer specifically formulated for indoor plants on their prayer plant.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that prayer plants benefit from fertilizers high in phosphorus and recommended monitoring for signs of improvement.
- [CHANGE] User noticed their prayer plant wasn't looking as vibrant and decided to try a new fertilizer.
